verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a pre-built app gallery supporting SAML/OIDC SSO and SCIM provisioning to common SaaS apps (Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.) with a portal to request additions, but none of the evidence cites the actual catalog size (thousands of apps) or quantifies setup speed ('minutes'), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of ease of connection. missing for 10: catalog size figures, time-to-connect evidence, independent corroboration of gallery breadth.
